name: kamal-deploy Action
description: GitHub Action to run Kamal 2 deployments from CI, including destinations and optional image-push control.
details: Runs Kamal from a GitHub runner and supports separate environment/config inputs and deployments using previously pushed images.
best_for: You want deployments to happen after CI instead of from a laptop.
caveat: Runners need SSH access and the required registry and app secrets.

name: kamal-complete
description: Bash, Zsh, and Fish tab completions for Kamal subcommands and flags.
details: Supplies shell completion files and install instructions for common interactive terminals.
best_for: You use the Kamal CLI frequently and want quicker command discovery.
caveat: Install the variant for your shell; the project does not change Kamal itself.

name: Kamal-TUI
description: Terminal user interface for exploring and running Kamal operations.
details: An alternative interaction layer for Kamal operators who prefer navigable terminal screens to individual CLI commands.
best_for: You are evaluating a keyboard-first operations interface.
caveat: Review current command coverage and version compatibility before production use.

name: kamal-panel
description: Self-hosted SSH-based Kamal panel for status, logs, deployments, rollbacks, and notifications.
details: Uses Kamal commands and SSH access to collect fleet state and perform operational actions; includes log views and alert rules.
best_for: You run multiple apps and want a central operational interface.
caveat: Treat admin access and stored SSH credentials as highly privileged.

name: Helmsman
description: Local browser interface experiment for Kamal operations.
details: A project worth investigating as an alternative local interface for running deployment tasks.
best_for: You prefer a local UI to a hosted control plane.
caveat: A maintained README could not be retrieved during curation; review functionality directly.

name: Shipyrd
description: Team deployment dashboard fed by Kamal lifecycle hooks.
details: Runs as a Kamal accessory and gathers hook-driven deployment events to show releases to collaborators.
best_for: You want shared deploy status without replacing Kamal.
caveat: It has hosting and storage requirements; consult the setup instructions.
